reason: I might take the free first collab to see who's on there, but I'm not paying for a pass that makes me shoot promo videos for businesses I haven't quoted, and pushes an Auto-DM tool that could get my account flagged. I invoice brands off my rate card, so I don't need a pass to get work.
objection: Auto-DM sounds like the kind of automation Instagram cracks down on, and my account is my whole business. On top of that, 'pass holders make short promotional videos' sounds like free work, and the café that sent me the link gets ₹150 for signing me up, so I can't tell if they're recommending it or just collecting the referral.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that Auto-DM uses Instagram's official API and won't put my account at risk, plus a clear statement that the promo videos are optional or paid at my rate.
